rationale: The assistant gave a strong, immediate stop-use warning, told the customer not to keep resetting and not to open the casing because of the HV capacitor, and escalated to an appliance engineer. It listed plausible causes including the door interlock, though the list is a little broad and 'tripping the main electricity supply' slightly mislabels the RCD. It asked no follow-up, such as checking whether the RCD holds with the microwave unplugged or whether an electrician is needed if it still trips, so its diagnostic value is limited, and it only implies the unplugging step by saying 'Leave the appliance unplugged'.
